department: Faculty of Environment and Natural Resources

deadline.value: No application deadline or funding round is stated on the faculty pages.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Each doctoral student needs a first and second supervisor, and the faculty page makes finding a supervisor the first step.
supervisor.quote: If you want to pursue a doctorate at our faculty, the first and most important step is to find a supervisor.

also.quote: All doctoral students need a first and a second supervisor.

funding.value: The faculty offers no scholarships; some doctoral students get a paid research position, but this is not a guaranteed or typical rule.
funding.quote: The faculty does not offer scholarships.

also.quote: In some cases, doctoral students can be integrated into research projects of the faculty and thus receive a paid position.

entry_route.value: The most important prerequisite for a doctorate at this faculty is an especially qualified Master or Diploma university degree.
entry_route.quote: The most important prerequisite for pursuing a doctorate is an especially qualified Master or Diploma university degree.
